text_generation.reason: Shared Brand DNA + PIM + category context; avoid 3 separate text calls.

image_generation.rule: If user selects quantity N for an image type (e.g. hero=3), make N image calls. Same image type + same shared context; only the variant prompt changes.
image_generation.reason: Do not invent a new endpoint per variant. Reuse one image-call path; vary only the prompt.

shared_context_rules: Build sku_context once per SKU from brand_dna + channel_rules + pim product.
Pass the same sku_context into text batch and every image call.
Do not re-load Brand DNA / category intelligence / PIM for every attribute or variant.
After text succeeds, pass generated title + bullets + highlights into image prompts for consistency.

title.structure: [Brand] + [Opacity Claim if stated] + [Door/Window Curtain] + [Pack Count if stated] + [Design/Pattern] + [Material if stated] + [Color if stated]

order: pack contents + stated material/pattern/color (no invented dims)
opacity / room-darkening or light-filtering claim only if stated
design / room-use benefit grounded in product_name
brand quality / finish tone from Brand DNA (no fake hardware claims)
what is included / use occasion without inventing care instructions

item_highlights.style: short scannable benefit chips for A+/gallery overlays
item_highlights.rule: No invented size or care chips

hero.goal: Product-led catalog hero; optional tiny official logo only; no marketing text overlays
hero.logo: official brand_logo_primary stamped after generation; never invent logos
quantity_variants: variant_1: straight-on full-drape hero, clean room context
variant_2: angled/side fall hero showing fabric depth and fold
variant_3: tie-back / partially drawn hero showing versatility

infographic.goal: Marketplace overlay image with crisp Brand DNA typography on solid callout cards
infographic.logo: official logo stamped after generation; never invent logos

card.background: solid opaque white or soft cream
card.layout: right-third vertical stack; curtain remains dominant

infographic.lighting: clean catalog daylight; soft even fabric light; no HDR bloom
quantity_variants: variant_1: side-panel benefit icons with solid cards
variant_3: exploded spotlight without invented LBH

lifestyle.goal: LOAI-style lifestyle concept: premium editorial Indian home scene WITH one required adult lifestyle model; curtain pattern-locked; no dense text overlays
quantity_variants: variant_1: morning living ritual with adult model; curtain hero
variant_2: evening privacy mood with adult soft in frame; curtain readable
variant_3: host-ready room with adult; architectural depth

a_plus.goal: LOAI-style Premium A+ module: wide composition, benefit chips from highlights, optional adult model, design-system palette
quantity_variants: variant_1: premium module strip with benefit chips
